Parish bookstore

Books, icons and things for the home

The bookstore keeps a small, carefully chosen stock: Scripture and prayer books, icons for the home, incense, candles and prayer ropes. Everything below is browsed and bought in person at the bookstore table. Reserving something ahead of Sunday is a proposal — the parish has no ordering system yet.

Proposed — no ordering system yet
How collection would work
1. You would reserve what you would like below.
2. The bookstore would set it aside and confirm it with you.
3. You would collect and pay at the bookstore table after Liturgy.

None of this exists yet. The Reserve buttons through this page are inert, and no address or system has been invented behind them.
